_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment. See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mgr-tenant-entitlements container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mgr-tenant-entitlements container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mgr-tenant-entitlements container in MiB

deployment.description: mgr-tenant-entitlements keeps entitlement flow state in PostgreSQL and its async-confirmation sweeper only fails flows that are stale in the database, so replicas can run side by side behind a load balancer. A synchronous entitlement request is executed by the replica that received it. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Kong proxy timeouts applied when the module registers itself in the gateway. The read timeout is raised to 360s because a synchronous entitlement request runs the whole flow (module installation, route and Keycloak setup) before it responds; connect and send keep the Kong defaults.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name holding the mgr-tenant-entitlements schema

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host. Used to publish entitlement, capability, system-user and scheduled-job events and to consume resource-result confirmations

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
EnvVars.description: Security protocol used to communicate with Kafka brokers (PLAINTEXT or SSL)

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Logical deployment name, used as the Kafka topic prefix; must be unique across all environments sharing the same Kafka cluster and match the value used by the other modules. Falls back to 'folio' when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Tenant collection name for tenant-specific topics; must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30}. ALL is the value used by the other FOLIO modules. When unset, empty or false, per-tenant topics are used. Any other value fails the module startup

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SEND_DURATION_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: How long the event publisher waits for a Kafka acknowledgment before the send fails

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_ENTITLEMENT_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the entitlement topic created at startup

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_ENTITLEMENT_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the entitlement topic; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SCHEDULED_JOB_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the scheduled-job topics created for entitled tenants

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SCHEDULED_JOB_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the scheduled-job topics; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CAPABILITY_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the capability topics created for entitled tenants

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_CAPABILITY_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the capability topics; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the system-user topics created for entitled tenants

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_SYS_USER_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the system-user topics; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RESOURCE_RESULT_TOPIC_PARTITIONS
EnvVars.description: Number of partitions of the resource-result topic and its dead-letter topic

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RESOURCE_RESULT_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor of the resource-result topic and its dead-letter topic; the broker default applies when unset

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_RESOURCE_RESULT_TOPIC_CONCURRENCY
EnvVars.description: Number of concurrent consumers of the resource-result listener

EnvVars.name: EVENT_PUBLISHER_AWAIT_COMPLETION
EnvVars.description: When true, capability, system-user and scheduled-job publishing stages stay IN_PROGRESS after publishing and wait for a resource-result Kafka acknowledgment before finishing. When false, stages finish as soon as the publish succeeds

EnvVars.name: ASYNC_CONFIRMATION_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: How long a flow may wait for async stage confirmations before the sweeper marks it FAILED. Applies only when EVENT_PUBLISHER_AWAIT_COMPLETION is true

EnvVars.name: ASYNC_CONFIRMATION_SWEEP_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Fixed delay between runs of the sweeper that fails flows with overdue async confirmations

EnvVars.name: FLOW_ENGINE_THREADS_NUM
EnvVars.description: Number of threads in the flow engine executor pool; controls overall parallelism of entitlement flow stages

EnvVars.name: FLOW_ENGINE_MODULE_INSTALLER_THREADS
EnvVars.description: Number of threads dedicated to module installation; controls how many modules are installed concurrently. Keep it at or below FLOW_ENGINE_THREADS_NUM

EnvVars.name: FLOW_ENGINE_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Maximum execution time of a synchronous entitlement request. On expiry the flow and its in-progress stages are marked FAILED and the request returns 400. Asynchronous executions are not bounded by it

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_INTERFACE_INTEGRITY_ENTITLEMENT_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables interface-integrity validation for entitlement operations

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_INTERFACE_INTEGRITY_UPGRADE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables interface-integrity validation for upgrade operations

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_INTERFACE_INTEGRITY_STATE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables interface-integrity validation for desired-state requests

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_INTERFACE_COLLECTOR_MODE
EnvVars.description: How required and provided interfaces are collected for validation: scoped collects them per application and its dependencies, combined collects them across all applications together

EnvVars.name: VALIDATION_INTERFACE_COLLECTOR_EXCLUDE_ENTITLED_REQUIRED
EnvVars.description: When true, required interfaces of already entitled applications are not collected

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Connect timeout of the HTTP client used to call FOLIO modules during entitlement

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_CLIENT_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Read timeout of the HTTP client used to call FOLIO modules; raised well above the 30s code default to match the reference environment

EnvVars.name: MT_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-tenants, called to read tenant data. The tenant.url property is accepted as an alias

EnvVars.name: AM_CLIENT_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of mgr-applications, called to read application descriptors. The am.url property is accepted as an alias

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_MODULE_MAX
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of retries for failed calls to FOLIO modules

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_MODULE_BACKOFF_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Initial delay in milliseconds between retries of FOLIO module calls

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_MODULE_BACKOFF_MAXDELAY
EnvVars.description: Maximum delay in milliseconds between retries of FOLIO module calls

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_MODULE_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER
EnvVars.description: Multiplier applied to the delay after each retry of a FOLIO module call

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_KEYCLOAK_MAX
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of retries for failed calls to Keycloak

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_KEYCLOAK_BACKOFF_DELAY
EnvVars.description: Initial delay in milliseconds between retries of Keycloak calls

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_KEYCLOAK_BACKOFF_MAXDELAY
EnvVars.description: Maximum delay in milliseconds between retries of Keycloak calls

EnvVars.name: RETRIES_KEYCLOAK_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER
EnvVars.description: Multiplier applied to the delay after each retry of a Keycloak call

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on

EnvVars.name: MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_HEADER_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request header; raised above the server default to accommodate large JWTs

EnvVars.name: ROUTER_PATH_PREFIX
EnvVars.description: Prefix added to every endpoint path exposed by the module (/entitlements becomes {prefix}/entitlements). Set it when the load-balancer group has the form {host}/{moduleId}

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mgr-tenant-entitlements process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

EnvVars.name: SECURITY_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables request authentication and authorization. With KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true, Keycloak acts as the security provider

EnvVars.name: APIGW_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables API gateway integration. When false, all gateway-related beans are excluded: the module neither registers itself nor manages module routes

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TYPE
EnvVars.description: API gateway implementation used for route management and self-registration: kong or apisix

EnvVars.name: APIGW_URL
EnvVars.description: Admin URL of the API gateway. For apisix, the Admin API origin without the /apisix/admin path

EnvVars.name: APIGW_API_KEY
EnvVars.description: APISIX Admin API key sent as X-API-KEY. Required when APIGW_TYPE=apisix, ignored for kong

EnvVars.name: APIGW_REGISTER_MODULE
EnvVars.description: Defines whether the module registers itself in the API gateway (creates its own service and routes from its module descriptor) at startup

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: URL at which the API gateway reaches this module; used as the upstream when the module self-registers. The module cannot determine it behind a load balancer

EnvVars.name: APIGW_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Read timeout in milliseconds set on the gateway service of this module at self-registration; keep it in line with the kong read timeout

EnvVars.name: APIGW_ROUTEMANAGEMENT_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables creation and removal of module routes in the API gateway during entitlement and revoke. When false, only gateway services are managed

EnvVars.name: APIGW_TENANT_CHECKS_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: When true, a tenant-specific header filter is added to each module route on entitlement instead of a wildcard route, and removed on revoke

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend holding the Keycloak admin client secret. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_ENV
EnvVars.description: First segment of the secure store key, for example prod or test. Defaults to the value of ENV, with fallback to 'folio'

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM; when unset the AWS default region provider chain is used

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the IAM role of the running task for SSM authorization instead of explicit credentials. Applies when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM

EnvVars.name: KC_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables Keycloak integration: Keycloak-based security, creation of Keycloak resources on entitlement, and token refresh for long-running operations. When false, all Keycloak-related beans are excluded

EnvVars.name: KC_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL of Keycloak, used for resource management and token requests

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_BASE_URL
EnvVars.description: Override base URL for JWKS retrieval. When empty, the issuer URL from the token iss claim is used. Set it to reach Keycloak through an internal address instead of the public one

EnvVars.name: KC_IMPORT_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: At startup, creates or updates the module's own records in Keycloak (resource server, client, resources, permissions, roles, policies) from its internal module descriptor

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Keycloak admin client used for resource management and for refreshing tokens during long-running operations. Its secret is read from the secure store, not from an environment variable

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_GRANT_TYPE
EnvVars.description: OAuth2 grant type used to obtain the Keycloak admin token

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Connect timeout of the Keycloak admin client (Spring Duration syntax, e.g. 10s, 500ms)

EnvVars.name: KC_ADMIN_READ_TIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Read timeout of the Keycloak admin client (Spring Duration syntax, e.g. 60s, 2m)

EnvVars.name: KC_CLIENT_ID
EnvVars.description: Client ID under which the module registers itself in Keycloak when KC_IMPORT_ENABLED=true

EnvVars.name: KC_LOGIN_CLIENT_SUFFIX
EnvVars.description: Suffix appended to the tenant name to derive the login client ID used when creating client resources during entitlement (e.g. diku-application). Must match the value used by mgr-tenants and the module sidecars

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTH_TOKEN_VALIDATE_URI
EnvVars.description: When true, validates that the Keycloak URL matches the issuer of the incoming JWT

EnvVars.name: KC_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in minutes between scheduled JWKS cache refreshes for the realm JWT parser

EnvVars.name: KC_FORCED_JWKS_REFRESH_INTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in minutes for forced JWKS refreshes of the realm JWT parser; applies to signing key rotation

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_MAX_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of Keycloak access tokens held in the token cache

EnvVars.name: KC_AUTHORIZATION_CACHE_TTL_OFFSET
EnvVars.description: Offset in milliseconds subtracted from the token lifetime when computing the cache TTL of a cached access token, so a token is dropped before it expires
